title: NLTK launcher and file extraction paths permit code execution or overwrite
summary: Relative prover9/mace4 locations can execute planted binaries. Unvalidated Java launcher tokens bypass JAR restrictions. ZIP extraction can follow pre-planted hardlinks and overwrite files outside the data root.

severity.rationale: The flaws require local planting or attacker control of specialized launcher configuration. They cross intended execution and file boundaries but are not unconditional remote execution.

affected.note: Prover9/Mace: <=3.10.3. Java bypass: >=3.10.3,<3.10.4. ZIP hardlinks: >=3.9.4,<=3.10.3. All fixed in 3.10.4.

exposure: Prover9 requires a relative binary_location and a writable resolved directory. Java requires control of launcher arguments and a JAR or argument file. Extraction requires a pre-existing hardlink inside the data root.

params.instructions: Check nltk version, affected release line and the documented exposure conditions.

remediation.action: Update or contain the affected component
remediation.details: Upgrade to 3.10.4 before using these helpers or downloading corpora.
remediation.risk: Medium. Updates can interrupt workflows and require compatibility checks.

verification: Confirm the deployed release meets the corresponding fixed version and verify the affected workflow with harmless test inputs.

review.notes: Independent reviewer re-read every tier 1 source and checked every field. No open findings.

history.change: Initial record drafted from directly inspected primary sources for independent review.
